title: DZ08_Melana - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 1 NPC from DZ08_Melana.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by DZ08_Melana (DZ08_Melana.esp).

Install this if DZ08_Melana.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
